lessons.title: 1.1 XI — Nasri mutala aur zaban
lessons.content:
## Learning outcomes
Read prose by identifying the central idea, author's purpose, characters, events and style. Use context to infer unfamiliar vocabulary and support answers with evidence from the passage.

## Study method
Read the prescribed textbook section, note key terms, prepare a short outline and answer using relevant examples or evidence.

## Study method

sd.question: هن موضوع تي ترتيبوار جواب لکو ۽ دليل ۽ مثال شامل ڪريو.
sd.modelAnswer: سنڌي مدد: تحقيقي لکڻيءَ ۾ سوال صاف، ماخذ معتبر ۽ حوالو درست هجي. رسمي درخواست، رپورٽ ۽ خط ۾ مقصد ۽ ادب وارو انداز رکو.
